hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central South America, northeast of Argentina, southwest of Brazil || grassy plains and wooded hills east of Rio Paraguay; Gran Chaco region west of Rio Paraguay mostly low, marshy plain near the river, and dry forest and thorny scrub elsewhere || landlocked; lies between Argentina, Bolivia, and Brazil; population concentrated in eastern and southern part of country || Resources: hydropower, timber, iron ore, manganese, limestone || Exports: soybeans, beef, electricity, corn, soybean meal (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: grassy plains and wooded hills east of Rio Paraguay; Gran Chaco region west of Rio Paraguay mostly low, marshy plain near the river, and dry forest and thorny scrub elsewhere || Central South America, northeast of Argentina, southwest of Brazil

climate.excerpt: subtropical to temperate; substantial rainfall in the eastern portions, becoming semiarid in the far west || local flooding in southeast (early September to June); poorly drained plains may become boggy (early October to June)

economy.excerpt: upper middle-income South American economy; COVID-19 hit while still recovering from 2019 Argentina-driven recession; global hydroelectricity leader; major corruption and money-laundering locale; highly agrarian economy; significant income inequality || Exports: soybeans, beef, electricity, corn, soybean meal (2023) || Industries: sugar processing, cement, textiles, beverages, wood products, steel, base metals, electric power
